authorized_transport.current_module: SettingsUI; public Swift API in WhitegramBackendTransport.swift
authorized_transport.current_api: WhitegramBackendAuthorizedTransport(userId: Int64).execute(path: String, query: [URLQueryItem] = [], method: String = GET, providerKey: String? = nil, body: Data? = nil, bodyFile: URL? = nil, contentType: String? = nil, accept: String = application/json, maximumResponseBytes: Int = 8388608, received: ((Data) throws -> Void)? = nil, progress: ((Int64, Int64) -> Void)? = nil, completion: (Result<WhitegramBackendHTTPResponse, WhitegramBackendError>) -> Void) -> WhitegramBackendTask
authorized_transport.semantics: Account-specific Keychain session, application/device/optional session signatures, fixed historical host and TLS pins, redirect denial, response limits and serial main-queue callbacks. In-flight authorized requests actively cancel on account session/access changes and recheck before headers/chunks/progress/completion. HTTP responses including non-2xx retain response.statusCode, headers, data, duration: transport success is not provider success. X-Provider-Key is allowed only under /v1/proxy/. received sees 2xx chunks; throwing a non-backend error aborts with invalidResponse. bodyFile is exclusive with body, bounded to 512 MiB + 4096 and caller-owned until completion, including cancellation. Nonproxy 401 invalidates only the matching session; provider 401 is preserved without deleting the Whitegram session. A known Retry-After can preempt a subsequent request with http(429).
authorized_transport.authentication_api: WhitegramBackendAuthentication(context: AccountContext), retained by caller; connect(completion: (Result<Void, WhitegramBackendError>) -> Void), cancel(). Both called on main. Auth cancellation suppresses obsolete callbacks. connect success requires a saved matching session and verified allowed beta verdict. transport.hasSession() throws -> Bool; transport.disconnect() throws removes only its user's backend session and invalidates access.
authorized_transport.access_api: transport.accessState -> WhitegramBackendAccessState (.unknown/.allowed/.denied); transport.refreshAccess(completion: (Result<WhitegramBackendAccessState, WhitegramBackendError>) -> Void) -> WhitegramBackendTask. Parent may observe whitegramBackendAccessUpdated (userInfo.userId Int64) and call whitegramBackendAccessState(userId:).
authorized_transport.access_validation: Recovered GET /v1/beta/status?user_id=...&nonce=... uses a fresh 32-hex nonce and application/device signatures. Ed25519 validation uses the original image55 0x55b528 key and image46 0x217fa0 canonical payload. User, nonce, expiry, 120-second future skew and maximum 600-second signed lifetime are checked. Original positive/negative cache bounds are 900/30 seconds; this implementation additionally expires a cached grant at its signed expiry. Only validated server verdicts populate the account-bound memory gate. Noncritical requests reject unknown/denied and recheck callbacks. No public grant setter.
provider_proxy_blockers: Transport and signed server gate are implemented; native regressions require macOS. Caller must connect its account and refreshAccess before noncritical requests. Unknown and denied remain distinct.

Historical authenticated access and beta entitlement are not available for verification. Further original evidence (image55 0x55b888) confirms absent/invalid signed server verdicts remain unknown; local channel membership is not a fallback grant in that gate.
authorized_transport.provider_integration: Services can integrate now using the original provider path it recovered, query items, X-Provider-Key and response.statusCode handling. Groq incremental chunks and VirusTotal file-body uploads/progress are supported. Keep the upload file stable until completion. Native and authenticated acceptance still require validation; no direct fallback is performed by this transport.

storage_and_schema.server_owned_state: Profile about/quote/lyric/badge/scene/reaction/wall state comes from validated server responses and mutations. Generic local catalog boolean writes do not constitute publishing. No shared generated schema was edited by backend.
storage_and_schema.session_vault: Keychain service com.whitegram.backend.sessions.v1, account session.<TelegramCloudUserId>; token, expiry, optional decoded session key; AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly, nonsynchronizable.
storage_and_schema.session_migration: Reads original wg_apiSessionToken_<id>, wg_apiSessionExpires_<id> (Unix seconds), wg_apiSessionKey_<id> (base64). Saves and verifies the matching account session before removing those three legacy values. Malformed/expired/failed imports and existing stored sessions are retained.
storage_and_schema.device_identity: Preserves original com.whitegram.deviceIdentity.p256 SecKey tag. Reads original token service com.whitegram.deviceToken / account wg_stableDeviceToken, then old wg_stableDeviceToken preference, before UUID creation. New vault device-token entry is verified; original Keychain source is retained.
storage_and_schema.wallpaper: Documents/WallpapersProfile/my_wall_<userId>.jpg; original account-specific wg_profilePhotoWallPublic_<userId> is written only after successful publication/deletion. Local-file changes alone do not claim remote changes. This is not the global generated profilePhotoWallPublic boolean; archive restore must not trigger network publication.
storage_and_schema.scammer_cache: Read-only wg_scammerRemoteIdsV1 comma-separated IDs and wg_scammerRemoteIdsV1Timestamp; unavailable/corrupt are distinct. No network refresh is fabricated.
storage_and_schema.local_diagnostics: WhitegramBackend.RequestCounts.v1 stores installation-local UTC daily path counts, pruned around a 30-day window. It is not an account/server billing source and stores no request query/body/token.
storage_and_schema.ephemeral_state: Beta grants, profile response caches, cooldowns and bounded pending streak events are memory-only. Confirmed-message payload omits text/media. Queue limit 256 and per-peer/direction 60-second throttle. No preference import grants entitlement.

parent_integration: Both registries are now imported by the parent installer; combined map has 35 owned Swift files and unique destinations. Preserve the registry API rather than hardcoding an earlier file count.
Use the public authentication/transport/access APIs for provider proxy integration. Preserve non-2xx bodies/status. Services owns provider-specific routes and response parsing.

Parent owns menu/capability routes. Route service-backed settings to owned controllers; do not treat a generic stored switch as a completed backend mutation. Only CloudUser numeric IDs belong in these APIs.

Parent menu eligibility can observe whitegramBackendAccessUpdated and query state. Unknown and denied must remain distinct; critical status/auth requests remain available. Do not infer allowed from hasSession().

Startup currently registers primary accounts and message events lazily register their account. Parent account lifecycle can explicitly register other active accounts for legacy migration/access refresh and call transport.disconnect() on intentional backend logout.

Connect local wallpaper and scammer assessment adapters to original profile rendering as appropriate. Native inline cards, styles, rich-text/animation/scene/flame rendering listed under remaining_keys are not supplied as complete originals.
Shared preferences/archive mirror integration must respect account-specific wallpaper/session keys. Auth credentials remain in Keychain; no archive import may grant access or publish content.
